items.title: Review and approve minutes of the regular meeting of August 3, 2026
Report in connection with law enforcement agreement and any action regarding District security
Discuss and consider Energy Physical presentation, and take any necessary action
Authorize Indemnification of Directors and take any necessary action
Receive and approve Tax Assessor and Collector’s Report, including payment of bills
Discuss tax rate recommendation with Financial Advisor
Adopt Order Designating Officer to Calculate and Publish Tax Rate
Receive and approve Bookkeeper’s Report, payment of certain bills, and investment report
Review Engineer’s Report, including approval of pay estimates/change orders, approval of capacity commitment requests, and authorizing necessary action related to plans
Discuss and consider amending the District Rate Order, and take any necessary action
Review and approve Operator’s Report, including approval of accounts to be written off, approval of hydrant inspections, and necessary action relating to District’s facilities
Report from Ethoscapes regarding detention ponds, and take any necessary action
Discuss and consider proposal for additional mowing at Darbydale Pond, and take any necessary action
Review monthly website analytics; and any matters that may properly come before the Board
